name: variable_op
description: Create, update, or delete a NuCore variable (an integer counter or a state flag routines can reference in their conditions/actions -- call list_variables for the current list, and see create_or_update_routine's var_ref()/set_var()/while_repeat() for how a variable is referenced inside routine logic). This tool manages the variable itself, not routine logic. `value`/`init` here are the RAW stored integers, same as list_variables returns -- not display values, do not scale them yourself. Create: type + optional name/prec (the hub assigns the id, returned in the response). Update (id required): only the fields given change, everything else is left as-is -- name/prec/value/init are all optional. Delete: type + id only.

type.description: 1 = integer variable (a counter; changing it does not re-trigger routines that reference it in a condition). 2 = state variable (changing it does re-trigger routines that reference it in a condition).

id.description: Real variable id, as returned by list_variables. Required for update/delete, omit for create.

prec.description: Precision (decimal digits val/init are scaled by). create/update only.

value.description: New current value, as a RAW stored integer (not scaled/unscaled). update only.

init.description: New init value (what the variable resets to when a routine runs set_var(..., op="init") on it), as a RAW stored integer. update only.
